item.title: Aokigahara Forest: The 'Sea of Trees' on Fuji's Lava Plateau — Guide
item.description: Aokigahara Forest, known as the Jukai or ‘Sea of Trees’, is a dense woodland grown atop a hardened lava plateau formed by an ancient eruption of Mount Fuji over a thousand years ago, its trees rooted in the rocky volcanic ground rather than deep soil. The forest offers well-marked nature trails and access to lava caves, including atmospheric ice caves that stay cold year-round, and while it has a reputation in popular culture, for visitors it is simply a striking and unusual volcanic woodland best explored along its established, signposted paths.
